Thanks for the context. 30 minutes is perfect for a focused sandbox walk-through. We can cover: quick model/quantization recommendations, a live call to the hosted API to see response characteristics, and a short checklist for batching/prefix caching.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Jun 6, 9:30–10:00
- Tue Jun 6, 11:00–11:30
- Wed Jun 7, 08:30–09:00

If any of those work, reply with your preferred slot and we'll send a calendar invite. Naomi — looping you in to provision a short-lived sandbox API key and a tiny test dataset for PaperPlane (TTL 48h). Diego — I’ll ask you to bring the 1-slide cost/latency tradeoffs so Leah has an idea of unit economics post-demo.

Prework (short):
- Share one or two representative prompts (or a small CSV of examples)
- Note expected average request size (tokens in + expected tokens out)
- Optional: a short description of desired latency SLOs (e.g., sub-200ms 95th)

Attaching a one-page agenda and a short provisioning checklist.

Best,

A couple quick notes:
- We'll bring two prompt families: short search reranking examples and a follow-up completion family used in chat flows.
- Typical payload is ~120 tokens input, expecting ~80 tokens out.
- Latency target is ~<250ms 95th if possible; we'll use the live numbers to decide whether to optimize with batching or a compact model.

Can you send the calendar invite (we use Google Calendar) and the sandbox key details and any quick pre-population steps? Naomi — happy to coordinate if you need a sample CSV.
